entries.basis: Monthly-timeframe accumulation zones for a 10-25yr horizon: where fundamentals + monthly support align to add in small portions. 'entry' = start nibbling at/below; 'add' = deeper monthly support to load more. Pakistan macro-aware (SBP 11.5%, KSE-100 off the Jan ATH). These are accumulation guides, not precise buy/sell signals — verify with your broker.

MZNPETF.note: Broad Islamic index ETF — your #1 DCA vehicle. Accumulate on any dip; entry is just under fair value, add = deeper monthly support.

MIIETF.note: Second index-ETF leg. Same DCA logic — buy small and often, more at the add level.

MEBL.note: Core compounder but ran up (~554). Start adding on a pullback to ~540; back up the truck at/below Rs 500 (the standing allocation line).

MIF.note: Actively managed Islamic equity fund (NAV-based). Accumulate on monthly dips.

FABL.note: Islamic-conversion deposit growth intact; +39% on cost. Add on a dip toward monthly support ~91, more near 85.

NATF.note: Consumer-staple compounder. Rarely cheap — accumulate patiently on dips to ~355, more near 335.

FATIMA.note: Strong H1 (profit +20.7%), concessionary-gas edge. Add on a pullback to ~147; watch the new PIA Equity capital commitment.

BWCL.note: Cement upcycle, dividend payer, FY26 payout now fully paid out. Accumulate near monthly support ~460, more at 435.

GLAXO.note: Defensive pharma with pricing-deregulation tailwind. Add on dips to ~322.

SEARL.note: Pharma margin recovery underway. Accumulate near ~82 — today's price sits inside the zone.

CPHL.note: Fundamentals intact, REIT demerger value-unlock still pending EGM/court approval. Fair add zone ~71.

GHGL.note: Solid industrial, cheap on earnings. Add on a dip to ~39.

MUGHAL.note: Steel cyclical — NOT a forever hold. Only add near cycle-support ~73; be ready to trim on a doubling.

DCR.note: REIT — income play with steady rental dividends. Add for yield near ~38; inflation hedge.

EFERT.note: INCOME, not growth (WATCH). Only add for the yield near ~174; urea glut not confirmed cleared — don't overweight.

AIRLINK.note: HIGH BETA, policy-dependent — cap the position. Only small adds near ~125; trim on sharp rallies.

FFL.note: Turnaround, KEEP SMALL. Tiny adds only near ~14.5; take profits if it runs 50%+.

AVN.note: NOT a buy. H1 FY26 swung to a net loss (EPS -0.62); the thesis is broken. This is an exit candidate, not an accumulation — do not average down.

UPFL.note: Only 3 shares (~Rs 76K), illiquid. Exceptional company but immaterial to portfolio decisions — no accumulation plan.
